body:
Apple AAPL reported fiscal Q3 earnings of $2.02 per share, a nice beat above $1.88 analysts were expecting and +29% year over year. Revenues of $109.4 billion surpassed the $108.75 billion in the Zacks consensus. It’s another record quarter for the iPhone maker, even if unit totals are no longer part of Apple’s quarterly numbers.
